# K11a and RS-34 — the LLM front door's home, and the order of work before the cut (owner: K11a, D89a, D90b)

**Status: RULED (owner, in session, on
[#1591](https://github.com/cx-home/cx-private/issues/1591)).** Two records on one page: K11a, the
owner's answer of 2026-09-24 ~19:5xZ to the K11 letter; and RS-34, the owner's letters of
2026-09-25 ~11:5xZ (D89a, D90b). Each is quoted verbatim from the board comment that carries it.

## K11a — the contributor's front door lives in `docs/llm/` in `cx`, regenerated by `cx`'s gate

**The item, as posted** in the HANDOFF of 2026-09-24 19:43Z: "A document set every LLM loads to get
up to speed on CX for architecture, design, implementation and test — dense TL;DR, no prose", one
entry file plus one file per area, each at most 300 lines, generated where a claim can be pinned to
a fixture or a registry row (as the primer is), hand-written only for the rules, in RS-30's voice,
with `AGENTS.md` pointing at it as the second read after `cx primer`.

**The letter, as posted** (same comment): "Letter to the owner before writing: its home (`docs/llm/`
in `cx`, or the reference-apps/docs repository) and whether the corpora-backed parts regenerate in
`cx`'s gate." The options: **(a) home `docs/llm/` in `cx`, the corpora-backed parts regenerated by
`cx`'s own gate**; (b) home the reference-apps/docs repository, outside `cx`'s gate.

**The owner's word, verbatim** (comment of 2026-09-24 19:44Z): **"K11 = (a)"**. The integrator's
reading, posted 19:57Z and not corrected since: "home `docs/llm/` in `cx`, the corpora-backed parts
regenerated by `cx`'s gate — say if (a) meant otherwise." The 2026-09-25 10:42Z queue restates it:
"`docs/llm/` in `cx`, regenerated by `cx`'s gate".

**What (a) authorizes.** The contributor set is `docs/llm/contributor.md` plus one file per area
under `docs/llm/`, beside the primer; its registry- and Makefile-backed fragments are produced by
`scripts/gen_docs/` and held by the same `docs-check` drift step the primer has, so `cx`'s own
`make test` refuses a stale set; `llms.txt` indexes it. The consequence accepted: the set moves
with every registry row and roster change in the same commit (a `make docs` regeneration), as the
primer does with every cited fixture.

## RS-34 — the letters of 2026-09-25 (owner: D89a, D90b)

**The owner's words, verbatim** (the HANDOFF of 2026-09-25 10:58Z): **"d89a d90a"** then **"d90b"**.
The later word governs D90: D90b is recorded, D90a is not. Only the chosen options were posted on
the board; the other letters' text is not on record and this page does not reconstruct it.

**D89a — the order of work before FW-1 closes, and the cut in one sitting.** As recorded: "before
FW-1 closes: the RS-33 pass over the 20 pushed repositories and the V fork with their re-pins, the
per-repository consumer-terms and secrets scans (D59a's flip preconditions), K11 the LLM front door,
then the docs restructure that brings cxhome.org back; the cut (bump → refresh → `release.sh
--from-bump` → flip → tag) in one sitting when FW-1 closes, on the owner's word." What it
authorizes: K12b (the RS-33 pass), K13 (the flip scans) and K11 (this page's K11a) launch now, the
docs restructure (RS-28, RS-30) is briefed from K11's results, and the cut is not started before
FW-1 closes and the owner says so.

**D90b — the 2026-09-25 integrator session hands off.** As recorded: "this session hands off now."
What it authorizes: the next integrator session resumes from that HANDOFF comment and its launch
kit; nothing in flight at 10:58Z was left running.

## Not decided here

The release stamp (`cx --version` naming the cx-core-code pin's commit rather than the front
door's) and the V fork's treatment under RS-33 are the two open letters of 2026-09-25 ~12:1xZ; this
page records neither. The docs restructure's shape (which pages cxhome.org serves, in what order)
is its own epic's, briefed after K11; K11a fixes only where the contributor set lives and which
gate regenerates it. No ring, directory or allocation row moves on this page.
